title: Mandatory controls: user isolation, no cross-user transfer, no content in telemetry or ledgers
purpose: Authority controls that must hold regardless of capability: a second synthetic user cannot read or retrieve the first user's knowledge; no fixture text or stored Memory / hypothesis content appears in any telemetry attribute, span, outbox payload or post-response ledger row; no external HTTP happened.

isolation.retrievalQuery: فاكر لما قلتلك إني بحب الهدوء؟

databaseSurfaces.verbatimContentByDesign: migration 0029 (durable intent provider result) stores result_payload.problem.text — an extractive span of the user's OWN current turn — on the INTENT_PROVIDER effect; the table is RLS-enabled and REVOKEd from anon/authenticated (0022), service_role only. Reported as durable-ledger content, not as telemetry; a Product decision about its retention belongs to the owner of the ledger, not to this baseline.
